title: migrate leaves a settings entry for a hook it moved aside
what: When relay migrate moves a project's hook script aside (arsenal's .claude/hooks/issue-stage.sh), the project's settings no longer name it, or migrate does not move it; a settings entry never points at a file that is gone.
why: 25 Oct, the arsenal pilot design, scratchpad reports/design-arsenal.md (copy in ~/.relay/backup/scratch-3207dc59), section 1.1 (read in lib/relay_setup.py, not run): migrate moves issue-stage.sh aside but merge_settings keeps its settings entry, so every prompt in the project would run a missing hook. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen), before the pilot.
failing_case: A temporary project with .claude/settings.json naming .claude/hooks/issue-stage.sh: after relay migrate, the file is moved and the entry stays.
pass_cases: After migrate, no settings entry names a missing file; a hook migrate leaves in place keeps its entry.

fact: Migration 27 Oct: the link in `why` line 1 points to a session file (`reports/design-arsenal.md` of 25 Oct, section 1.1), which is deleted when the machine restarts; the facts it held that this item rests on are the notes below.
